what: features, hashes and probabilities of the dynamic-option evaluation's items; no request text

families.brand: Amazon Shopping Queries (ESCI) US products, Apache-2.0; brand list adds Wikidata English brand labels (CC0)
families.product: Amazon Shopping Queries (ESCI) US queries, Apache-2.0

arrays: per pool: k (real options per item, the none option is one more in p), static (8 features of the real options), keys (hash of the normalised option text, uint64), gold (index, K-1 for none), p_<base> and served_<base> (distributions over the options)
note: derived numbers only: no state or option text is stored; the hashes are of short option strings from public datasets
